C++ — Texture Alignment and Completion

Correspond alignment.cpp, all are calculated locally. The external luminous direction is depth/The cloud coordinates are linked to the texture camera coordinates:`P_texture = R × P_depth + T`.

alignTextureImage Depth Load

Purpose: A one-stop off-line alignment of depth inverse projection, texture sampling and fast invalid zone completion.

Parameters

Name Type Description

const std::vector<uint8_t> &

Texture image data.

int

Value of textureW.

textureH

int

Value of textureH.

int

Value of matType.

const std::vector<float> &

Depth data in millimeters.

depthW

int

Value of depthW.

depthH

int

Value of depthH.

depthIntrinsic

const std::vector<double> &

Value of depthIntrinsic.

textureIntrinsic

const std::vector<double> &

Value of textureIntrinsic.

const std::vector<double> &

Value of textureDistortion.

const std::vector<double> &

Value of rotation.

translation

const std::vector<double> &

Value of translation.

alignedTexture

std::vector<uint8_t> &

Value of alignedTexture.

Returns: bool. matType=16 (CV_8UC3) Every channel at the time 1 Bytes;`matType=18 (CV_16UC3)` Every channel at the time 2 bytes. The nudity pointer output capacity shall be multiplied by the actual channel bytes.

Example: Parsing and aligning external references

std::string metadata;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::getEpicRawElementMetaDataStr(
        document, TFTech::EpicRaw3DataType::TextureBGR, metadata)) return;

std::vector<double> textureMatrix, textureDistortion, rotation, translation;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::parseTextureExtrinsics(
        metadata, textureMatrix, textureDistortion, rotation, translation)) return;

std::vector<uint8_t> aligned;
bool ok = TFTech::EpicEye::alignTextureImage(
    texture,
    textureWidth,
    textureHeight,
    matType,
    depth,
    depthWidth,
    depthHeight,
    depthMatrix,
    textureMatrix,
    textureDistortion,
    rotation,
    translation,
    aligned);
